outfits.name: Soot-Black Leathers
outfits.description: Apron and gloves in a black that hides the soot, which in Kettleport is most of what clothes are for.

outfits.name: Oxblood Leathers
outfits.description: A deep red hide, oiled until it shines. Nobody has ever been overlooked in it.

outfits.name: Gauger's Green
outfits.description: Dyed the green of old copper, as the Gaugers wear it. They do not hand it out to people who guess.

outfits.name: Board Blue
outfits.description: The blue of a Board clerk's ledger cloth. It suggests that somebody, somewhere, has signed for you.

outfits.name: Guild Plum
outfits.description: A purple no dyer will sell to one customer. Guilds order it by the vat.

outfits.name: Foreman's Gold
outfits.description: Yellow enough to be seen from the far end of the bench, which is what it is for.

backdrops.name: No. 9
backdrops.description: Your own workshop, on one of its tidier days.

backdrops.name: Sprocket Row
backdrops.description: The Row at lamp-lighting, when every window is somebody else's unfinished job.

backdrops.name: The Heaps
backdrops.description: Rustmoor behind you, at a distance from which it looks almost restful.

backdrops.name: Open Sky
backdrops.description: Nothing behind you but weather, which is how the airship captains like to be painted.

backdrops.name: The Cinderworks
backdrops.description: Furnace light, by leave of the Stokers. It flatters everybody and warms nobody.

backdrops.name: The Exchange Floor
backdrops.description: The price board over your shoulder, by leave of the Counting-House. The figures are a week old.

backdrops.name: The Guild Hall
backdrops.description: The long table and the banners, with everybody else just out of the picture.

derivation: Work order 042. GDD section 8 prices cosmetics at 5 to 30 Cogs, looks only, and section 5 lets Favour open a faction's cosmetics. Jeremy, 15 November 2026: the two bodies are free picks; outfits and backdrops are bought in the Cog Shop, and some are earned through Favour instead. An outfit is a dye of the Tinker's leathers, applied to the drawn frames by scripts/art/dye_outfits.py, so each needs no new art. Prices and Favour levels are starting points for the assayer. Work order 043: three looks are bought with Guild Tokens, at 10, 20 and 35, where a week pays at most 15 and a guild doing the first tier of everything pays 5. Those are starting points too.
